items.event_time_ist: Rally held Tue, Oct 20, 2026 (reports published Oct 20, ~9:10-10:13 AM IST Oct 21)
items.summary: Trump held his Greenville, NC midterm rally Tuesday evening, Oct 20 — the rally happened (it was listed as upcoming in the rally-blitz item). He spoke nearly 2 hours (1h52m), one of the longest of the cycle, saying he is 'working like a dog' and noting a break from past midterms when he 'didn't really campaign': 17 campaign stops since the GOP's Dallas midterm convention, with 18 more rallies planned over the next 15 days and another NC stop before Election Day. He brought GOP Senate nominee Michael Whatley and down-ballot candidates onstage; Whatley trails Roy Cooper by ~10 in the RCP average. Retiring Sen. Thom Tillis told Politico the same day his fellow Republicans are headed toward 'a train wreck' and a 'whoop ass' in November — an on-the-record rebuke from within the GOP. Trump has traveled 29,000+ miles since late September.
items.title: Trump holds Greenville, NC rally (nearly 2-hour speech); Tillis warns GOP headed for 'a train wreck'

items.event_time_ist: Published Oct 16, 2026 (catch-up — missed during the Oct 14-20 coverage pause)
items.source_name: Cook Political Report + Washington Examiner + Political Wire
items.summary: Cook Political Report shifted 11 more House races toward Democrats on Oct 16 (all in the Dems' direction; missed by this watch during the Oct 14-20 pause). Solid R → Likely R: FL-16 (open), KS-2 (Rep. Derek Schmidt), NE-1 (Rep. Mike Flood). Likely R → Lean R: MN-1 (Rep. Brad Finstad), NY-21 (open), OH-10 (Rep. Mike Turner), OH-15 (Rep. Mike Carey), SC-1 (open). OH-1 (Rep. Greg Landsman) went Lean D → Likely D; FL-25 (Rep. Jared Moskowitz) went toss-up → Lean D; MT-1 (open) went Lean R → toss-up. House editor Erin Covey: half the changes are in Ohio, Nebraska and Kansas — three states that also have competitive Senate races — and Dems are competitive in Obama-won districts that swung to Trump in 2024, with many Trump +10 districts now 'firmly in play.' Confirmed via Cook's own release (forecaster) + Rep-leaning Examiner + independent Political Wire.
items.title: Cook Political Report shifts 11 more House races toward Democrats (Oct 16, catch-up)

items.event_time_ist: Announced Oct 17-18, 2026 (venue confirmed Oct 19 via RNC site + FGCU president email; rally scheduled Fri, Oct 23, 2026)
items.source_name: Naples Daily News (USA Today network) + Coral Springs News + South Florida Reporter
items.summary: New Trump rally confirmed for Fort Myers, FL on Fri, Oct 23 — venue confirmed over the Oct 17-18 weekend as FGCU's Alico Arena (4,633 capacity) via the RNC's event site; FGCU President Aysegul Timur confirmed the finalized rental in a campuswide email Oct 19, with the university shifting most operations remote for the day. Doors 10:30 AM, program 12:30 PM, Trump remarks ~2 PM. The stop is in FL-19, home district of GOP gubernatorial nominee Byron Donalds (Stetson poll: Donalds +11). Trump himself posted that TWO Florida rallies are already scheduled for Donalds — Fort Myers plus a second TBA. Also circulating: a seven-rally/7-day sprint schedule among supporters (10/19 Wichita, 10/20 Greenville, 10/21 Clemson, 10/22 Sioux City, 10/23 Fort Myers, 10/24 Macon, 10/25 St. Clair County MI) — the MI 10/25 stop is only via a partisan blog so far and is held unconfirmed.
items.title: Trump Fort Myers, FL rally Fri Oct 23 confirmed at FGCU's Alico Arena; Trump says two FL rallies planned
